name: AI-2027 Live Agent
description: Evidence-first execution agent: a deterministic planner over a real kernel (projects/agi-system) that refuses to claim success without an independent verifier and a hash-matching artifact on disk. Every VERIFIED run is offered to an evidence-gated memory store.

skills.name: Create a file inside an isolated run sandbox
skills.description: Writes content to a path inside a per-run sandbox. Path traversal (POSIX and Windows) is DENIED by policy, not by convention. Success requires 5/5 independent verifier checks: claimed_ok, file_exists, correct_path, correct_content, hash_matches.

honest_limits: No LLM in the loop: the planner is deterministic and rule-based. This card describes what runs, not what is planned.
Memory retrieval is lexical (hashed uni/bi-grams), not neural. Measured: 16/16 on corpus-vocabulary queries, 2/16 on paraphrases.
No authentication or tenancy: this is a single-tenant demo surface. Do not expose it to the public internet as-is.
The agent cannot prove outcomes it did not verify: unverified runs are reported DENIED/FAILED/INCONCLUSIVE and are refused by the memory gate.

verification.rule: A claim is valid only if an executed command reproduces it.
